status: Phase B. Scene metres: x east, y up, z south, origin at the DEM grid centre (UTM 8N 429600 E, 6543510 N). Targets use the published landmark coordinates in public/data/terrain-meta.json. Budget: each shot <= 25 s, total <= 90 s (55 s used). Never played during assessment (the app blocks it).

captions: Muir Inlet, Glacier Bay, Alaska. Real elevation data, true scale.
In 1941 ice filled this inlet. Muir Glacier was a tidewater glacier that calved into the sea.
Ahead: the place-name coordinate of Muir Glacier today.
shots.description: The camera flies low up a long fjord between snow-capped ridges, heading north-west toward the head of the inlet.
